objective: Add local read-only input snapshots, explicit change/failure receipts and separately hash-bound human review records for brief and earnings trials.
non_goals: No production, nightly, U4, paper or SMC changes.
No network/provider/model calls, automatic research judgment, scheduled job activation or team access.
No replacement of human trial feedback or PR merge approval.
input_contracts: Existing brief/earnings request and source hashes
Local input files, previous verified follow-up package
Separately authored human review bound to exact report version
output_artifacts: New immutable local follow-up directory containing request, source copies, report and check receipt
Standalone validated review record without approval authority
Readable local status page suitable for later workbench read-only integration
acceptance_tests: Reject altered source, parent or report; source failure cannot reuse prior green; unchanged data cannot count as new evidence.
Review requires exact version and complete item coverage; correction does not overwrite original; no human approval generated by machine.
approval_gates: Human trial feedback and research criteria remain pending until supplied.
Draft requires full offline CI and independent code review; merge separately authorized.
Network collection, scheduling and workbench service deployment are subsequent steps, disabled here.
